manifest.claim_text: Operator / mechanism claim is controlled for. Primary metric: Timing, direction, dose/state dependence and unique intervention forecast.
manifest.falsified_by: The mandatory control (Equal-capacity generic operator, alternate mechanism and learned-residual controls; hold out discriminating perturbations) shows the result survives only without it.
manifest.consequence_if_failed: Minimum interpretation enforced: A mechanistic label is earned only by predictions a generic surrogate misses
non_goals: This gate does not claim a validated digital twin of any specific person.
This gate does not claim that any admitted operator is neurally realized.
No prospective human TMS/tFUS protocol is implemented or implied (build order stops at item 5; item 6 is out of scope: no IRB, no consent, no participants).
